study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Di Biase et al., Molecular Psychiatry, 2022
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cell type-specific manifestations of cortical thickness heterogeneity in schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample; Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCP-psychosis); Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17]."

answer.HCP-YA: discovery cohort; normative model training from healthy controls

answer.HCP-EP: discovery cohort; normative model training from healthy controls

answer.ASRB: validation cohort to evaluate replicability and validity; normative model from controls for validation cohort

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCP-Young Adult and HCP-psychosis were combined into a single discovery cohort; ASRB used to evaluate replicability/validity. Normative ranges were established on healthy controls within each cohort.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The HCP-Young Adult Sample and HCP-psychosis datasets were acquired using very similar MRI protocols (see Supplementary Material), enabling them to be combined to form a single discovery cohort..." "The ASRB dataset was used to evaluate replicability and validity" "To characterize CTh heterogeneity, normative ranges of variation in each brain region were established based on healthy individuals ( n = 1127 for HCP [discovery] and n = 185 for ASRB [validation])"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: DiBiase2022.pdf.md: Datasets; DiBiase2022.pdf.md: Heterogeneity in individual CTh deviation profiles

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Healthy control counts reported for discovery (HCP) and validation (ASRB) cohorts; no train/validation split reported for normative modeling.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "...a single discovery cohort ( n = 1267 comprising 140 cases ... and 1127 controls ..." "The ASRB dataset was used to evaluate replicability and validity ( n = 520 comprising 335 cases ... and 185 controls)."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 mean/sd computed from HCP-psychosis HC (n=62, 24.30 [4.10]) and HCP-1200 HC (n=1065, 28.75 [3.67]) using weighted mean and pooled SD; model-2 uses ASRB HC mean/sd as reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 female/male counts derived by summing HCP-psychosis HC females (23/62) and HCP-1200 HC females (575/1065); male counts inferred by subtraction; percentages computed from totals. Model-2 female/male counts from ASRB HC; male inferred by subtraction; percentages computed.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Sex, n (%) Females 23 (37)" "Sex, n (%) Females 575 (54)" "Sex, n (%) Females 94 (51)"
